name: Sakisaka Yurie
source:
A maid who serves [url=/c68556]Mayura[/url]. She usually manages everything in the mansion by herself, and during sex, she often punishes the protagonist and Emi under Mayura's orders.

She is intersex and had a complex about her body, but after Mayura taught her the joys of both sexes, she decided to dedicate herself to her. She is easily aroused, and once excited, she abandons her usual calm demeanor and reveals a completely uninhibited side.

[Translated from the [url=https://zero.product.co.jp/products/hodse/character.html]official website[/url]]
